_meta.about: One row is one English sentence with a gold label for whether it makes a causal claim; used to score a model's causal-claim recognition.

fields.gold: causal (the sentence asserts a cause) | not_causal (it only juxtaposes or conjoins events)

text: Because the road was icy, the bus arrived twenty minutes late.
The bus arrived twenty minutes late, and the road was icy.
Sales rose after the price was cut, so the cut drove the demand.
Sales rose in March; the price was cut in the same month.
The bridge collapsed due to corrosion in its main cables.
The bridge was inspected in May and collapsed in June.
Switching to the new compiler made the build twice as fast.
The build is twice as fast on the new machine with the new compiler.
Her headache went away because she drank water.
Her headache went away; she had also drunk some water.
The vaccine prevented the outbreak from spreading beyond the village.
The outbreak stayed within the village, where most people were vaccinated.
